data.one_liner: Natural language date parser for Dart that extracts dates from text.
data.what_it_does: Chrono parses English date expressions in strings and returns DateTime objects along with their positions. It supports relative terms like today, tomorrow, and ranges such as "17 Aug 2013 – 19 Aug 2013".
use_when: Parsing dates in chat or messaging apps
Extracting event dates from user input
Converting natural language dates to DateTime for scheduling
avoid_when: Highly ambiguous or custom date formats not covered by the parser
strengths: Handles a wide variety of English date/time formats
No external dependencies beyond Dart SDK
weaknesses: No built‑in unit tests for custom patterns
data.setup_notes: Add dependency in pubspec and import package; no build_runner or permissions required
